title: Visual Asset Project Request
description: Input to the `Visual Asset Project` reusable workflow (and its dev test webhook). Mirrors the Step 6/7/8 orchestrator request shape. See docs/architecture/visual-asset-pipeline.md#input.

target_shot_ids.description: Shot IDs to force-regenerate even if a completed, identity-matching asset exists (targeted human revision). Empty/omitted means a fresh full plan.

revision_trigger.description: Why this run was started. Defaults to initial_generation when omitted.

_dev_fail_after_step.description: Dev-only failure-injection escape hatch — never part of the public contract.
